kronis.bio: KRONIS is the solo project of Ontario guitarist and songwriter Aaron Kronis, combining alternative rock guitar with electronic beats. Kronis spent 13 years in Los Angeles before returning to Ontario. He previously played in the band Thermocline. His three released albums are LUCK, Against the World and Generation XLNT. Released in 2020, Against the World took three years to make with producer Parker Ament. Kronis is also working on a new EP, American Icon, in Canada. Through his streaming channel, KRONIS TV, he plays guitar live for listeners. His single "Next To Her" joined Northern Dial's library in November 2026.
